Answer: Entertainment & Music is more common than Health

The data has no labels, so I classified the questions myself. I first used keyword searches for each topic. Then I read every match and judged its topic by hand.

- **Entertainment & Music:** about 30 clear matches. These include questions about songs, bands, movies, TV shows and celebrities.
- **Health:** about 17 clear matches. These include questions about diet, sleep, medication, infections and symptoms.

These are approximate counts. The keywords may have missed some questions, so the totals are not exact. I think the gap is large enough that the answer holds.
